Package io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    Tag<T>
    Version-independent replacement for org.bukkit.Tag.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BlockDataCompat
    Compatibility helpers for the org.bukkit.block.data.BlockData API, which only exists from Minecraft 1.13 onwards.
    BukkitKeys
    Java-8 universal port: bridges Slimefun's own NamespacedKey to the real org.bukkit.NamespacedKey at the (1.12+/1.14+) server-API boundaries (PDC, registries, recipe lookups).
    EntityCompat
    Compatibility helpers for entity-related API that changed across Minecraft versions.
    HandCompat
    Java-8 universal port: cross-version main/off-hand item access.
    InventoryCompat
    Java-8 universal port: Inventory#getStorageContents() is 1.9+.
    ItemMetaCompat
    Java-8 universal port: reflective access to ItemMeta methods that do not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor.
    ItemsAdderCompat
    Java-8 universal port: ItemsAdder (dev.lone.itemsadder.api.CustomBlock) is an optional third-party plugin, not a compile dependency, so its API is reached reflectively.
    KeyedCompat
    Java-8 universal port: Keyed#getKey() (returning a NamespacedKey) is 1.13+.
    MaterialCompat
    Java-8 universal port: cross-version Material helpers for APIs added after 1.8.8.
    NbtItemCompat
    Java-8 universal port: stores Slimefun's item id in real item NBT on pre-1.14 servers, where the PersistentDataContainer API does not yet exist.
    ParticleCompat
    Java-8 universal port: cross-version particle spawning.
    PdcCompat
    Java-8 universal port: a single, fully-reflective Persistent-Data (PDC) abstraction.
    PotionCompat
    Java-8 universal port: compatibility helpers for the base-potion API that does not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor.
    ProfileCompat
    Java-8 universal port: the player-profile API (Bukkit#createPlayerProfile, PlayerProfile, PlayerTextures, SkullMeta#setOwnerProfile) arrived in 1.18 and does not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor.
    RecipeCompat
    Java-8 universal port: ShapedRecipe#getChoiceMap() (returning Map<Character, RecipeChoice>) is 1.13+.
    ReflectionCompat
    Java-8 universal port: a tiny reflective method invoker for calling Bukkit/Paper APIs that do not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor but are present on newer servers.
    RegistryCompat
    Java-8 universal port: org.bukkit.Registry (1.14+) does not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor, so it cannot be referenced as a type.
    SoundCompat
    Java-8 universal port: cross-version sound playback.
    VersionedEnchantment  
    VersionedEntityType  
    VersionedItemFlag  
    VersionedParticle  
    VersionedPlayerHead
    Java-8 universal port: applies head textures across versions.
    VersionedPotionEffectType  
    VersionedPotionType  
    VillagerCompat
    Java-8 universal port: the Villager.Profession enum gained NITWIT (1.11) and NONE (1.14), and the leveled-trade setters setVillagerExperience/setVillagerLevel are 1.11+.
    WorldCompat
    Java-8 universal port: cross-version World helpers for APIs added after 1.8.8.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    SoundCategory
    Java-8 universal port: a version-independent stand-in for org.bukkit.SoundCategory (introduced in MC 1.11).
